text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
So, how was it? The celebratory gift 
written by my very own hand!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I didn't have any washi, so I wrote it on 
whatever scrap paper I had on hand, but 
it's the thought that counts with these 
things, right?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes... Um, I was very happy. ......

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(Right, because I'm so happy... I can't 
tell her! I can't say her handwriting is 
so artistic that it looks like an abstract 
painting...!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(However! I can't just give a fake review 
and thank her when I can't even read it! 
In that case—!!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I shall state it just as I see it!! What 
captured my heart at first glance was the 
dynamic, rhythmic motion of the 
brushstrokes!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
The vigor in the upward flick that sends 
ink flying! The curved brushstrokes 
blending softness and audacity...! All of 
that, well... coming together—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oho! So you understand! I poured my soul 
into the crane's feathers and the turtle's 
shell!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! Aren't cranes and turtles the 
ultimate lucky charms? I drew them in 
hopes of wishing you a long life!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(...A drawing was the right answer!? Since 
it was written on letter paper, I totally 
thought...)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...I shall return to my room and 
appreciate it properly once more!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oho, you like it that much?! Drawing it 
was well worth the effort then!! 
Nyaaa-hahaha!!
